comments.body:
***Extra Information***

Tech Rank: 2
Consumed Gauge: 50
Range: 100
Shatter Range: 60

Requires 2 seconds before the activation.
With advanture job it requires just one second before the activation.

Effect:
No effects, it will only deal damage. Higher Trap increases the damage out-put. Further more, adding this in your original tech can add blind-effect + increases the shatter range of the created Tech.
